text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Ahhhh, ouch ouch ow ow OW! I've really done it this time…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: You don't think me injuring myself is going to lower everyone else's morale, do you?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: What if it makes everyone afraid to train?! What… have I done?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Oh, I know! I just need to take a quick march through the academy!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: It might be painful and difficult… but if I put on a brave face, it'll put everyone at ease!
choice_data_list: There's nothing to worry about, so just get some rest.
If you're only walking, I guess it's okay.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: But! But! What about the Umamusume who might be feeling uneasy because of me…
choice_data_list: They'll definitely see through your act.
They'll definitely see through your act.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Ugh, you're right. If they notice me struggling, it'll just make things worse.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Uuuuugh, this suuucks… When pushed to the limit and her mobility's taken away, what does a simp have left?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Drum roll, please! All that's left is love… But, ugh… I wish that love could help me walk…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I make Agnes Digital rest and try to cheer her up.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: All right! Let's hurry up and go already!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Owwww!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Huff, wheeze… Get a hold of yourself, Digitan. Picture your oshis. Banish all other thoughts from your mind and the pain will change into glory…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sure enough, trying to force herself to move was a bad idea. Her recovery is delayed as a result.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Okay, fake it until you make it! I feel great! The picture of health! Take a good look, beloved Umas!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Wait a sec… I feel like I actually do feel better now that I've walked a bit…

text_block_list.name: Digital's Classmate
text_block_list.text: Hey, Digital! You're already up and walking around? What a relief! I'm so happy for you!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: O-o-o-of cooourse! As you can see, there's absolutely nothing to worry about!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: …Yes! I was able to protect their precious smiles.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Actually, I feel much better after seeing her smiling face! Umas really do make the best medicine! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With some light exercise, and maybe thanks to the smile of one of her oshis, Agnes Digital makes a quick recovery.
